question: do you want this quality-based automatic routing in the MVP—where callers request a task and Exchange selects a provider using its performance record?
decision: Quality-based automatic inference routing is part of the Exchange MVP.
routing_order: Enforce provider-selected audience and caller authorization
Filter supported task, availability, limits and accepted free/paid terms
Select among eligible providers using the chosen quality/performance evidence policy
unresolved: Who evaluates provider quality and operates validation
Retaining explicit provider selection alongside automatic routing
not_selected: Automatic payment or execution authorization from a quality score
supersedes: Earlier blanket deferral of quality-routing work from the MVP; broader consensus/reputation network remains undecided.
implementation_status: not implemented by this decision; existing configured ranks are not validated quality scores
